sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The gameplay of Plush Eggs Vending Machine is straightforward yet challenging. Players are presented with a vending machine that dispenses chocolate eggs, each containing a surprise plush toy. The goal is to crack open the eggs by clicking on them with your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls. As you progress through the game, the eggs become increasingly difficult to crack, requiring strategic thinking and planning.

The game features a simple yet intuitive interface that makes it easy to navigate and play. The vending machine is the central element of the game, and the eggs are dispensed randomly, ensuring that each playthrough is unique.
